# CS4U.ICU

> A comprehensive self-learning platform for computer science students featuring curriculum guides, course evaluations, development environment setup, and learning methodology resources.

CS4U.ICU is a community-driven CS education resource hub primarily serving Chinese university students. It aggregates curated learning paths from csdiy.wiki, evaluates top university CS courses, and provides practical guides for development environment configuration across Windows, Linux, and mobile platforms.

## Key Topics

- Self-learning Guide
- CS Curriculum
- Course Recommendations
- Development Environment
- Windows Development
- C/C++ Programming
- Learning Methodology
- GitHub & Git
- Visual Studio & VSCode
- Linux & Ubuntu
- WSL & Terminal
- Computer Science
- Undergraduate Education
- Chinese Universities
- Resource Sharing
